      "ingredients": [
        "15 parts honey",
        "2 sextarii wine",
        "4 unciae ground pepper",
        "3 scrupuli mastic",
        "1 dragma bay leaf",
        "1 dragma saffron",
        "5 roasted date pits",
        "5 dates",
        "18 sextarii mild wine"
      ],
      "directions": [
        "Put 15 parts honey into a bronze vessel.",
        "Add 2 sextarii of wine to cook the honey.",
        "Heat with a slow fire and dry wood, stirring with a rod while it cooks.",
        "If it begins to boil over, check it with a spray of wine; when the fire is removed, it returns to itself.",
        "When it has cooled, light it again. This will be done a second and third time.",
        "Then finally remove it from the fire, and the next day, skim it.",
        "Grind 4 unciae of pepper, 3 scrupuli of mastic, 1 dragma each of bay leaf and saffron.",
        "Take 5 roasted date pits and 5 dates softened with wine, and with a prior pouring of wine in its own manner and quantity, grind them so that a smooth grinding is obtained.",
        "When all these are prepared, add 18 sextarii of mild wine.",
        "Finally, add 2000 coals."
      ],
